effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
jurisdiction: writing fast with a longtime fr
purpose: I need something in writing fast with a longtime friend because I loaned them money in pieces over the last 8 months. It started casual with Venmo, cash, and paying a bill for them, but now the total is around $8,700 and we never made clear dates, interest, or what happens if they miss payments. They keep saying they’ll “take care of it soon” but nothing structured happens. I don’t want to ruin the friendship or sound hostile. I want something fair that confirms the total owed, monthly repayment plan, late payment expectations, ability to pay early, no weird surprises, and a respectful way to handle disputes. Clean, practical, and relationship-preserving.
title: Agreement
